posts.text: Hindustan Insulators and Industries Limited, A maker of electro-porcelain high tension insulators (33kv-765 kv) for transmission lines, substations, transformers and rail electrification, from one plant at Mandideep, Madhya Pradesh with a capacity of 20640 MT (capacity expansion in progress 6 new kilns to double capacity to over 40,000 MT). Part of the 70-year old Hindustan group; BSE only, Renamed from Hindustan Urban Infrastructure in Feb 2026. ELEVATOR PITCH Hindustan Insulators makes high voltage insulators for India’s grid build out. Revenue grew 25% to 331 cr in FY26, H1 27 profit was 92…
